description: Current time from a reliable server clock: UTC ISO timestamp, Unix seconds and milliseconds, and optionally the local date, time, weekday, and UTC offset in any IANA time zone (daylight saving handled). Useful because language models don't know the current date or time. Not charged for an unknown time zone. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

tz.description: Optional IANA time zone, e.g. America/Chicago.

name: get_time
title: Current time: UTC, Unix, and local time in any IANA time zone
